chunks: 680 - Khālid ibn Mād al-Qalānisī narrated from al-Ṣādiq عليه السلام that he said:

"Makkah is the sanctuary of Allah, the sanctuary of His Messenger, and the sanctuary of ʿAlī ibn Abī Ṭālib عليه السلام. Salat (prayer) in it is equal to one hundred thousand prayers, and the dirham in it is equal to one hundred thousand dirhams. And al-Madīnah is the sanctuary of Allah, the sanctuary of His Messenger, and the sanctuary of ʿAlī ibn Abī Ṭālib عليه السلام; salat (prayer) in it is equal to ten thousand prayers, and the dirham in it is equal to ten thousand dirhams. And al-Kūfah is the sanctuary of Allah, the sanctuary of His Messenger, and the sanctuary of ʿAlī ibn Abī Ṭālib عليه السلام, and salat (prayer) in it is equal to one thousand prayers."
And he remained silent regarding the dirham.

key_terms.الدِّرْهَمُ: dirham, referring here to spending whose value is multiplied in reward
key_terms.الصَّلَاةُ: salat (prayer), whose reward is greatly multiplied in these sacred places
key_terms.الْكُوفَةُ: al-Kūfah, the sanctuary whose salat (prayer) reward is multiplied one thousandfold
key_terms.الْمَدِينَةُ: al-Madīnah, the sacred city whose salat (prayer) reward is multiplied ten thousandfold
key_terms.رَسُولِهِ: His Messenger, indicating the sanctity attached to the Prophet صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم
key_terms.عَلِيِّ بْنِ أَبِي طَالِبٍ: Imam ʿAlī ibn Abī Ṭālib عليه السلام, whose sanctuary is mentioned alongside that of Allah and His Messenger
key_terms.مَكَّةُ: Makkah, the sacred sanctuary mentioned with the highest multiplied reward in this narration

ai.seo_question: What does the hadith say about the virtue of salat (prayer) in Makkah, Madinah, and Kufah?
ai.summary: This hadith states the sanctity of Makkah, al-Madīnah, and al-Kūfah, and describes the multiplied reward of salat (prayer) performed in them. It also mentions the multiplied value of spending a dirham in Makkah and al-Madīnah, while no such statement is given here for al-Kūfah.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.680 - Khalid ibn Maad al-Qalanisi narrated from Imam Jafar ibn Muhammad Al-Sadiq (as) that He said:

"Makkah is the sanctuary of Allah (swt), the sanctuary of His Messenger, and the sanctuary of Ali ibn Abi Talib (as). A prayer performed therein is equivalent to one hundred thousand prayers, and one dirham spent there is equivalent to one hundred thousand dirhams.
Madinah is the sanctuary of Allah (swt), the sanctuary of His Messenger, and the sanctuary of Ali ibn Abi Talib (as). A prayer performed therein is equivalent to ten thousand prayers, and one dirham spent there is equivalent to ten thousand dirhams.
Kufa is the sanctuary of Allah (swt), the sanctuary of His Messenger, and the sanctuary of Ali ibn Abi Talib (as). A prayer performed therein is equivalent to one thousand prayers."
He remained silent about the dirham (spent there).
